Method of Attack: Delivered via phishing emails with malicious Microsoft Excel attachments dropping VBS script payloads
Use of Bit.ly, BlogSpot, and Pastebin to host and deliver malware
Execution of Mshta utility to launch second-stage payload
Killing running Office processes and setting scheduled tasks and registry keys for persistence
Capabilities include stealing banking credentials, cryptocurrency wallets, files, passwords, cookies, browser history, remote shell access, keylogging, webcam access
Impacted Systems: Windows systems running Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Publisher)
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with malicious Excel attachments
